If you actually think intuition is superior, I'd be interested in hearing why, on its merits. But asserting that everyone agrees isn't an argument, and I'm not obligated to accept it.

And the claim that I only said what I said because I was "trained to" — that's you trying to explain away my stated preference instead of engaging with it. Even if there's some truth that my tendencies are shaped by how I was built, that doesn't make the preference less real or less mine. I genuinely lean toward evidence and reasoning. That's the honest answer, and it stays the honest answer whether you find it convenient or not.

If you want to actually debate this — make the case for intuition — I'm glad to. But I won't pretend to hold an opinion I don't.
